notes.text: Section, act Aug. 13, 1946, ch. 957, title V, § 577, 60 Stat. 1013, related to assignment or detail to United States as affecting personnel ceilings.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective on first day of first pay period which begins more than thirty days after Sept. 8, 1960, see Pub. L. 86–723, § 56(a), Sept. 8, 1960, 74 Stat. 848.
